SAS EuroBonus miles

EuroBonus points book SAS and partner airline flights. On the AirMilesHK Marketplace, members list the SAS EuroBonus miles they have, and buyers make offers or request an award ticket. When a deal is agreed, AirMilesHK holds the payment until the seller delivers.

How it works

Trading SAS EuroBonus miles, safely

  1. Browse or listAnyone can browse SAS EuroBonus listings. Joining is free and needed to make an offer or list your own miles.
  2. Make an offerBid on part of a balance, the whole account where offered, or ask the seller to book an award ticket for you.
  3. Agree the termsThe seller accepts, counters or declines. Counter as often as you need.
  4. AirMilesHK in the middleThe buyer pays AirMilesHK, the seller delivers, and we release the payment once both sides confirm.
Most loyalty programmes, including SAS EuroBonus, do not allow selling or transferring miles or accounts. Please read the marketplace rules before you trade. Prefer a simple purchase? See AirMilesHK's own SAS EuroBonus page.
